```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The massive federal government is structurally and financially broken.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"For decades, the federal government has been pushed beyond its core functions, increasing spending to unsustainable levels.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Elected officials have overpromised and overspent, and now the bills are due.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Unless dramatic action is taken now, young Americans and their children will inherit an unprecedented legacy of enormous and unsustainable debt.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The interest on the national debt will consume an ever-increasing portion of the country's wealth.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The specter of national bankruptcy in Europe serves as a warning to the United States.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Over the last three and a half years, the current Administration added an additional $5.3 trillion to the national debt.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The national debt is approximately $16 trillion.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The national debt represents the largest amount in U.S. history.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"In fiscal year 2011, spending reached $3.6 trillion, nearly a quarter of the gross domestic product.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Adjusted for inflation, spending in fiscal year 2011 was more than three times its peak level in World War II.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"In fiscal year 2011, almost half of every dollar spent was borrowed money.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Medicare, Medicaid, and Social Security account for over 40 percent of total spending.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Current levels of spending and debt are harming job creation and growth.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Projections of future spending growth are catastrophic, both economically and socially.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Projections of future spending growth do not include the fiscal impact of Obamacare, which includes over $1 trillion in new taxes, multiple mandates, and a crushing price tag.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
